programme.title: Samaapan
programme.desc: This is the story of a Pandit, Tribhu Pandey. One day while returning from a funeral feast comes across a mysterious skull in the forest with many secrets.

programme.title: Share Baazaar
programme.desc: A satirical mockumentary that dives into the wild world of stock markets, where retail traders chase dreams, operators outsmart the game, and finfluencers sell hope (and courses). SHARE BAZAAR: Yahaan Sabhi Gyaani Hain is a sharp, hilarious take on the madness behind the money.

programme.title: Signature
programme.desc: A single mother, living in a small village, takes care of her little daughter’s educational expenses by doing tailoring work. One day, she receives a pension letter, for which she has to visit the Gramin bank. There, she encounters something unexpected.

programme.title: Sita Ram Chaddha
programme.desc: Sita Ram Chaddha's married daughter has the option to seek substantial financial assistance from her affluent brother, but her unique request ends up transforming the lives of everyone involved in unexpected and remarkable ways.

programme.title: Chumbak
programme.desc: "Chumbak" follows Aryan and Mitisha, once inseparable lovers, who reunite after years. The old flame reignites, but life has diverged their paths. Caught between duty and desire, they must navigate tough choices, testing their love against the changed tides of circumstance. A poignant tale of love's resilience in the face of reality.

programme.title: Live A Little Part 2
programme.desc: After 5 years, Nimisha and Atish meet again at a party. She is awarded Best Emerging Entrepreneur by none other than Atish. Atish couldn't let another day go by without confronting Nimisha. Both seem happy and has moved on in their lives until they realize they've been living in a delusion. They reminded each other of their Pact which was made 5 years ago. Live a Little . Then made sudden plans which led to unexpected confessions which led to the most memorable night of their lives.

programme.title: Sizzle Of Shadows
programme.desc: A doctor encounters a couple suffering from Dementia, and attempts to alleviate their condition. Upon receiving a call from the couple's son who lives in America, the doctor visits their home and is shocked to find the couple arguing and displaying symptoms of Dementia. The doctor diagnoses the woman with Lewy bodies Dementia, which causes visual hallucinations.

programme.title: Arjun
programme.desc: Arjun is a soldier who works more like a mercenary in a never-ending war. He willfully follows the brutal orders of his commanding officer until one day, his entire world turns upside down. Examining one soldier's journey toward redemption, we show that our shared humanity is always worth fighting for underneath the trappings of all that divides us.

programme.title: Vansh
programme.desc: Dive into the powerful narrative of Vansh, a heartfelt short film from Vidyarthi Studios & Pocket Films, that explores the societal pressures surrounding gender expectations. This gripping tale follows a father's fierce desire for a son over his beloved daughter, shedding light on deep-seated beliefs and cultural traditions. As he grapples with his emotions, this poignant story opens a discussion about love, acceptance, and true parenthood. Don’t miss this eye-opening film that promises to challenge perceptions and evoke empathy.

programme.title: Writer
programme.desc: A quiet evening between a writer and his wife unravels into a surreal exploration of love, memory, and hidden truths. As reality shifts, so do the stories they’ve been telling themselves—and each other.

programme.title: Suta
programme.desc: Suta (The Daughter) is the story of a bold and smart daughter who fights for the sacrifices of her mother which went unnoticed in the family. She emerges victorious and sees that her mother gains back her confidence.

programme.title: Taashe
programme.desc: Shiv Kothari, a village boy of 8 years is not at all interested to learn taashe (a musical instrument ), his family, and his ancestral business. What changes him so suddenly that he becomes keen to learn taashe. Who changes him so much that he decides to play taashe professionally. Watch a unique love and marriage story of two kids

programme.title: Thanks Mom
programme.desc: Thanks Mom is a human & a universal story of every mother & son that will melt your hearts away. The film's strength is its emotional value and connectivity to the viewers. It is the most honest & truest form of interpretation of a mother's role. It highlights a mom-son connection that is frayed and rough around the edges, filled with awkward silences and unsaid feelings that both find difficult to navigate but come around for each other when the time comes.

programme.title: The Footage
programme.desc: A spy dies in an elevator leaving a message on the CCTV footage. A lip-reader is called to find out what he said

programme.title: The Please Book
programme.desc: Dora is a small girl from a rich family who lives with her father, a busy businessman. Due to his busy schedule, he is unable to spend quality time with her. Dora is very lonely and she does not have any friends. Her loneliness ends when one day she finds an old diary with “The Please Book” written on its cover. Soon she discovers it’s not an ordinary diary but a magical book. She believes that whatever you write in The Please Book, comes true.

programme.title: Threes A Couple
programme.desc: 3 Lives Change after they cross each other's path on one auspicious night.

programme.title: U Equals To Me
programme.desc: Nikita and Neeraj know each other well, but their relationship feels awkward. Nikita finds Neeraj's touches repulsive. Aniket has proposed, but she can't let go of Neeraj. Why does she seem stuck between a rock and a hard place? What’s the matter with Neeraj? Is it some deficiency, disability or a disease? It would need a silver bullet to get them together. What if the silver bullet already exists, unknown to them?

programme.title: Vinyamswaha
programme.desc: You will take me for a ride in the sky, Vinay, when you become a pilot." These words have haunted Vinay throughout his life like a fearful shadow. Born into a Brahmin family, Vinay fell in love with a Valmiki girl. However, representatives of the caste-driven society, cloaked in prejudice, turned his love into a vile and grotesque joke. Today, Vinay is serving a life sentence for the rape and murder of his own girlfriend.

programme.title: Woh Khaas
programme.desc: A business tycoon bored with his monotonous work-life escapes from his corporate setup for a day and ends up meeting a girl, who like a dream changes him upside down in a real ‘Filmy Manner’. Woh Khaas is a jazzy tribute to Bollywood romances that tries to combine the reality of love and the flamboyance of Indian cinema in an entertaining and enriching way.

programme.title: Yaantrik
programme.desc: Siddharth is a novelist. He is known for his different types of writing patterns. He always talks to his soul for some creative suggestions. Now he wants to write about a character called "Yaantrik". Siddharth wants to write a book on Yaantrik but this time as an experiment he wants to become a Yaantrik and then write a book. He will follow the routine of Yaantrik. His inner soul is not convinced with this idea. After being blocked in his own idea how his inner soul helped him out is the film.

programme.title: Zindagi Ek Kashmakash
programme.desc: Zindagi Ek Kashmakash is a heart-wrenching story of a single mother, Rani, who has been abandoned by his boyfriend. Rani makes a living as a prostitute to support her only son, Ajay. Despite the harsh reality of her life, Rani is determined to provide a better future for Ajay. As Ajay grows older, he begins to worry that something is not quite right with his mother's job.

programme.title: Wazir
programme.desc: A crime thriller that showcases the tale of an impeccably executed murder, where the culprits cleverly evade justice through meticulous planning and a lack of incriminating evidence.

programme.title: Parinay
programme.desc: The narrative explores our thought processes, whose opinions we value, and how we handle a common issue faced by many couples: when a minor disagreement escalates into a pointless argument.

programme.title: Humraz
programme.desc: This is the story of a couple who tried to raise their voice against the undesirable practice of one community. Hamraz is a witness to the hero playing Ravanahatha and the incidents that happened to him... Sometimes the image that looks white is also black... Humraz is a story full of mysteries... The curtain will soon fall on all the secrets and the real story will come out in front of everyone..

programme.title: Love Range
programme.desc: In the bustling metro city of Mumbai, Ayush and Roohi's lives are turned upside down by the COVID-19 pandemic. When Ayush loses his job, Roohi decides to start a tiffin service to support the family, but Raj's traditional views and wounded ego create tension as he struggles with the idea of his wife being the breadwinner.

programme.title: Catharsis
programme.desc: A poignant journey of a man forced onto a path of self-discovery, exploring the depths of the human mind and spirit.

programme.title: Bahar Aa Chaman Prakash
programme.desc: Bahar Aa Chaman Prakash" delves into the story of a man reluctant to marry his lifelong acquaintance. Shutting himself away and avoiding his father, he faces the girl his father wishes him to wed. When she joins him and locks themselves in a room, they emerge with a revelation connected to the man's inner struggles. Will his father embrace this truth?

programme.title: Ban Chor
programme.desc: A thief sneaks into a wealthy home for an easy heist—only to find the wife’s secret lover already there! But when the husband arrives, the thief and the lover must hide together, leading to a night of pure chaos, panic, and comedy. Because in this house… "Har chor pe ek mor hota hai!"

programme.title: Barat
programme.desc: A Typical miser starts picking up a mysterious trail of money only to find out something unearthly lurking around!

programme.title: 10.30 Lets Go To School
programme.desc: Disha is an ordinary village girl with dreams like any other kid. Not only does she love her father unconditionally, but also her books and school. Life takes an unexpected turn when her Baba and Bua decide to discontinue their education. Her fate is about to meet that of thousands of other children who drop out of school every year. However, it is not so easy to give up. She is intelligent, confident and above all, determined to get back what she rightfully deserves, her right to dream!

programme.title: 23 B Raheja
programme.desc: 23B Raheja is a gripping one-night drama that peels back the glossy layers of the entertainment industry to expose the shadows lurking beneath. The story revolves around a celebrated casting director whose charm masks a long trail of manipulation and exploitation. His power begins to crumble when a young woman arrives at his door, posing as an aspiring actress—but with a haunting connection to his past. As the night unfolds, so does a tense game of revelations, where truth becomes confrontation and justice takes an unexpected form. Taut, timely, and unsettlingly real, 23B Raheja is not just a story of reckoning—it’s a mirror held up to the systems we too often ignore.

programme.title: A Tale Of An Onion Witch Chapter 2
programme.desc: One year after the mysterious events of part 1, a newly married couple comes across a lady who claims to be Mangla. They are warned about the 150-year-old Witch that wanders around at night asking for an Onion. Things go haywire when a small girl knocks for help at midnight.

programme.title: Aam Ka Achaar
programme.desc: Haunted by the riots that took his parents 20 years ago, Karan confronts the man who once loved him as a son—yet betrayed him in the worst way. Torn between revenge and forgiveness, he seeks meaning in the madness. A powerful story of loss, betrayal, and the fight for redemption.

programme.title: Adhure Poore Se Hum
programme.desc: Two college time friends embark on a long drive on a Sunday morning, leaving their bustling city lives behind. As they amble through the hilly roads, they reveal to each other, their old longings and hidden pasts. Their rose tinted nostalgia is broken and they come face to face with their imperfect lives.

programme.title: Ae Ajnabi
programme.desc: Pappu, a misunderstood dreamer, carries a ring for the unknown—waiting for love, waiting for meaning. On a fateful night, he meets Chandini, a mysterious stranger who changes his world in just five hours. As they share stories, laughter, and heartbreak, Pappu finds answers he never knew he needed. But was she ever real? Or just a gift from the sun? A poetic journey of love, loss, and destiny.

programme.title: Aflatoon
programme.desc: A narrative unfolding the tale of two brothers residing far from their home, eager to dispatch a sweet treat to their unwell father.

programme.title: Ahsaas
programme.desc: Ahsaas is the emotional journey of Sana, a devoted wife caught in society’s definition of a “complete woman.” As childlessness becomes a burden, her husband’s support becomes her strength—leading them to seek help and reclaim their peace, together.

programme.title: Akhiri Parchi
programme.desc: This movie serves as an inspirational tool for kids, helping them grasp the extent of their parents' sacrifices and efforts to ensure their lives are comfortable and fulfilling, despite challenging circumstances. It aims to convey a powerful message, encouraging children to maximize their available resources and strive for their best.

programme.title: Ansh
programme.desc: When Nidhi visits an orphanage with hopes of adopting, she is confronted by the unresolved trauma of losing her own child to kidnapping. As she battles grief and depression, she must find a way to heal and embrace life again. A poignant tale of loss, resilience, and the power of hope.

programme.title: Bahaar
programme.desc: Bahaar follows a young woman’s silent suffering inside a marriage built on expectations. Her dreams fade as she’s shamed for infertility—until the family finds a “solution.” A haunting story of societal pressure, dignity, and the myth of the perfect marriage.

programme.title: Ruk Jana Nahi
programme.desc: Rinku, a 28-year-old man living with his father, has lost his will to live. However, a wedding in his neighbourhood brings a constant stream of visitors who unknowingly delay his plans and ultimately restore his will to live and succeed.

programme.title: Family
programme.desc: Anvith's friend Karthik is leaving school and moving to another city as his parents are getting divorced. This news makes Anvith very sad. The reason for their divorce which Karthik reveals to Anvith is a regular heated argument between Karthik's parents. Then Anvith also starts noticing the same argument between his parents. So, Anvith decides to do everything right so that their parents don't fight, but end up ruining everything which leads to a more heated argument.

programme.title: Live A Little
programme.desc: It starts with an after-party sequence. It is late at night. Nimisha, 26, struggles to get a ride back home when Atish, 46, sees this and offers her help. She refuses at first but eventually agrees. The journey gives Nimisha a peek into her boss's life. As they reach Nimisha’s destination they are ready to move on in their lives, but the night has more to offer them. Due to a sudden turn of events, they end up under one roof and despite their differences, they help each other get a new perspective

programme.title: Charitra Varnan
programme.desc: A cab driver comes across a woman standing and crying along the roadside. He tries to help her and tells her that he would drop her home safely. What happens next will leave you stunned.

programme.title: Chashmishq
programme.desc: A tale of two budding lovers, their glasses, and the unforeseen challenges that come between their first kiss.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: We all have a fantastic life but we spoil it with our silly ideas of how to live it. This story is about how in trying to define a relationship, we actually end up confining it. One such definition is marriage and this is what is discussed in Cheers by two intimately close friends - one of whom is helping the other decide against a bad marriage that she has chosen to live with for some time now, thus stifling herself from all the happiness she is entitled to. While the intent of the friend seem questionable, the story is about why she trusts him more than anyone else with this issue that she is facing

programme.title: Countless
programme.desc: A man who decides to spend the night with a woman ends up spending countless nights with the same woman at the same time. Could this be punctuality, love, lust, or something completely different?

programme.title: Cratch
programme.desc: When two individuals coming from two different parts of society with completely distinctive thought processes COLLIDE there would be Chaos, Confusion & a lot of disagreement, but would there ever be an eye-opening conversation? Watch this short to find out Kamrul's unique take on Life and how it affects Manay's perception towards it.

programme.title: Bandage
programme.desc: A young-adult, aspiring boxer, Aditya, trains with his father to become the best. However, he starts questioning his ambition and skills to make it to the top. Battling with his own troubles, the father tries to motivate Aditya. Will the father-son duo emerge victoriously, or will they crumble down in the face of their adversities?

programme.title: Barking Bruno
programme.desc: Barking Bruno sheds light on the reality of modern life, where we often prefer pets over parents, viewing them as burdens. Rohit, content with his dog Bruno, contrasts sharply with his treatment of his father, Mr. Mehra, who feels neglected. However, when Mr. Mehra meets Bruno, his life takes an unexpected turn, albeit temporarily

programme.title: Believer
programme.desc: The story revolves around a young man who is struggling with his career and has to face tough situations on the financial front. In a state of dejection/ despair he has a dialogue with his inner self. His negative self talks him into addictions and resorting to drugs or committin suicide (escapist attitude) He usually feels at home in the company of his negative self and seeks solace here. Yet somewhere he is dissatisfied and constantly looking for his positive self, whom he has only abandoned

programme.title: Beshak
programme.desc: Story of a couple where the wife couldn’t find the difference between dream and reality and doubt enters into the relationship!

programme.title: Bhool
programme.desc: A young actor in dire straits assumes the identity of a retired Army Officer's son in real life to leverage his housing arrangement. The officer, battling memory loss, eventually uncovers the harsh reality about his long-lost son, prompting the actor to flee for his life.

programme.title: Broken Stars
programme.desc: An astrologer who has a fake beard is just like his profession. He is confused about the stars and how it determines anyone's future, he tricks people daily but He is worried about his daughter suffering from a disease, then one day as it happens his past somehow connects with his present which determines his future. it is a philosophical journey of a man who constantly questions the existence of sheer weirdness of the whole connection of our stars with lives and his realization

programme.title: Certitude
programme.desc: This movie shows the story of Arjun, a smalltown boy from Dehradun who decides to move to Mumbai for his further studies. So in his new surroundings, he is unable to trust anyone until he finds someone whom he can finally rely on throughout his journey in Mumbai.

programme.title: Chaar Pandrah
programme.desc: A suspense film about a military guy meeting a Stanger at the bus stop who asks him to stay at his house for the night, as he has a wrong ticket and his house is very far. But he starts to have strange feeling about the strangers wife.

programme.title: Chand Saanse
programme.desc: Here is a story of a woman, NAYAN, She is in the waiting room of a hospital where her father-in-law is admitted. In the waiting room she sees suffering of other people. It looks the waiting room is meant waiting for death. She meets an old man who has just lost his wife but he is not aware of it. He keeps on talking about his wife as if she is still alive. That makes NAYAN to ask a question. What is the difference between life and death? Knowing about it or being unaware about it?

programme.title: Chashmadeed
programme.desc: A 60 YO woman lives with her entitled 30-year-old son and his wife. She is a doting mother to him, and like any mother, thinks of her son as ideal. One morning, she starts having a strange issue with her eyes, as her vision keeps getting blurred in erratic spasms, like a camera going out of focus and back. Upon the recommendation of her 23-year-old hip and woke neighbor, she sets out to visit an eye clinic by herself. The solution offered at this eye clinic more than clears her blurry vision.

programme.title: Karjdar Bhola
programme.desc: In a small village, Bhola and Komal, a struggling couple, face financial hardships. Bhola, a simple laborer, and Komal, his smart and beautiful wife, are burdened by a loan from Seth ji, a corrupt man who harasses Komal. Bhola mistakenly believes Komal is involved with Seth ji, leading to a deep misunderstanding. Eventually, the truth comes to light, allowing them to overcome their challenges and find happiness together.

programme.title: The Visit
programme.desc: "A young woman returns home after a prolonged absence, enjoying a warm bond with her mother but strained ties with her father. Reconnecting with a previously misjudged acquaintance, she faces revived conflicts with her mother. Tasked with overseeing tuition students, an unforeseen incident alters their lives permanently. Her homecoming: a blessing or a curse?"

programme.title: Ticket Please
programme.desc: Manohar Kadam, a voluntary retired man, tries hard to establish a meaningful connection with his only son Aditya but fails. Later he follows his friend Professor's advice and tries to connect with his son through a smartphone. The short film follows the Journey of Father and Son relationship in this Digital Era.

programme.title: Beyond Failing
programme.desc: This film captures intricate nuances of student stress, competition the so called rat race, parent child relation and purposeless living vs. purposeful living.

programme.title: Bharam
programme.desc: A Hindi drama short film about an executive visiting a house to give away a Mercedes won by a housewife in a lucky draw and the confusion that follows.

programme.title: Bita Hua Pal
programme.desc: The film delves into the universal question of love and compatibility. It follows the journey of a woman named Mira, who, like many others, finds herself questioning the foundation of her relationship. As she navigates the ups and downs of her own love story, she reflects on the nature of love and the challenges of maintaining a lasting connection.

programme.title: Blame Game
programme.desc: A woman sits alone on a beach, lost in thought, until a stranger joins her, sparking a conversation that reveals a story about love, relationships, and the bitterness they can sometimes bring. She describes a once-loving bond that, over time, turned painful, leaving lasting scars.

programme.title: Haywire
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Steven Soderbergh of Ocean’s 11, 12 & 13 comes HAYWIRE. A Female Assassin covert operative is hired to various global missions to perform jobs which governments can't authorize. When the operation goes awry, she needs to use all of her skills & tricks to escape an international manhunt and eliminate the last remaining link of the conspiracy against her.

programme.title: Spytime
programme.desc: Anacleto, a former secret agent, is forced to come out of retirement and protect his son, Adolfo, when his arch-enemy, Vazquez, breaks out of prison and targets him

programme.title: Spytime
programme.desc: Anacleto, a former secret agent, is forced to come out of retirement and protect his son, Adolfo, when his arch-enemy, Vazquez, breaks out of prison and targets him

programme.title: Poseidon Rex
programme.desc: While searching for lost treasure, deep sea divers unleash a monster that causes havoc and destruction not only in sea but also on land.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.title: Redline
programme.desc: Redline is an auto/action thriller that features an extensive exotic car collection Phantom Rolls Royce, Lamborghini Murcielago, Enzo Ferrari, Ferrari F430, Ferrari Scaglietti and two Mercedes SLR McLaren AMGs. The film follows a gorgeous young automobile fanaticize driver who becomes part of illegal drag racing competitions organized by exotic car fanatics.

programme.title: Spytime
programme.desc: Anacleto, a former secret agent, is forced to come out of retirement and protect his son, Adolfo, when his arch-enemy, Vazquez, breaks out of prison and targets him

programme.title: Wrecker
programme.desc: Two beautiful young women taking a trip through the countryside, are terrorized by an unknown driver trying to run them down in a heavy duty tow truck.

programme.title: Wrecker
programme.desc: Two beautiful young women taking a trip through the countryside, are terrorized by an unknown driver trying to run them down in a heavy duty tow truck.

programme.title: Tekken: Kazuya's Revenge
programme.desc: Suffering from amnesia, a young man trying to discover his true identity is kidnapped by an underground crime organization and turned into a ruthless assassin

programme.title: Out Of Death
programme.desc: From the producers of The Irishman & Lone Survivor comes this thrilling story of Jack Harris (Bruce Willis) who must tap into his killer instincts to survive the wilderness and the human predators as he tries to help a woman who witnesses a crime and finds herself running from a rural mountain town's corrupt police department after she took a video of police killing a drug dealer.

programme.title: Haywire

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: ABC
programme.desc: For some people life is about triumph against all odds, for some; life is only about complexities. Some walk through this road aimlessly and some; actually become the bridge. ABC is a short film that showcases the dichotomy between two extreme yet simple individuals. It is an empowering film which has the dexterity & optimism to resonate amongst all sections of audience. As humans, we do tend to forget that we are but one world than just mere economy, that it can just take one human, just one moment, just one action to turn around the paths of millions. ABC; is just a sweet gentle reminder of this thought.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: Make Her Happy
programme.desc: Nandita and Rahul are to be married soon. They are a live-in couple. Things take a U-turn when Rahul gets a call from his ex-girlfriend 'Suhana'. Will Rahul be able to save himself? Watch to find out who has trapped whom.

programme.title: Harmless
programme.desc: A boy down on his luck. A girl looking for thrills. A plot is hatched. A kidnapping is staged. As far as crimes go, this one seems harmless. But, as with all things, there is a price to pay. A hefty price. Harmless begins as a crime-thriller and develops into a dramatic adventure with a little bit of romance thrown in.

programme.title: Laugh
programme.desc: A film about who we were and who we've become , how socialising was and where its reached ,how something as simple as laughing has taken a complicated turn

programme.title: Love, Bites
programme.desc: Love, bites is a romantic drama where the story revolves around the lives of Karthik, an artist, and Meghna, scientist. Their sexual chemistry is obvious to everyone. Even to those who haven’t seen them together, since they like to flaunt the hickeys on their body. But something changes in their equation when the hickey becomes a bridge of memory that leads to an old sexual encounter Meghna had which Karthik finds out about. Will Meghna be able to help Karthik erase the marks of her past? Or will Karthik just to have to wake up to a realization that the past, even though it haunts, might not be real.

programme.title: Agarbatti
programme.desc: Bhola, who is mentally challenged but still manages to survive by himself, selling incense sticks on the roads. An accident takes place near bhola, he doesn’t see the person clearly who is driving the car. Will he be able to tell the police about this incident?

programme.title: A Situation
programme.desc: A widower father, Pradeep has adapted to the challenging life of raising a daughter single-handedly after demise of his wife. One fine morning, she undergoes menstrual bleeding while taking a bath. Helpless and terrified she is locked inside the bathroom, not answering her father. He does not understand what to do next. This film shows that even today, periods stand as the biggest question to a lot of parents.

programme.title: 10.30 Lets Go To School
programme.desc: Disha is an ordinary village girl with dreams like any other kid. Not only does she love her father unconditionally, but also her books and school. Life takes an unexpected turn when her Baba and Bua decide to discontinue their education. Her fate is about to meet that of thousands of other children who drop out of school every year. However, it is not so easy to give up. She is intelligent, confident and above all, determined to get back what she rightfully deserves, her right to dream!

programme.title: Bena
programme.desc: After a set of jewelry goes missing, the police search Bena's bag. Her employers, Bhai and Bhabhi, are shocked to see the contents. They throw her out and Bena spends the day calling people for jobs. The family driver calls Bena and informs her that the set was found. Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. Why was Bena thrown out of her job? What in the bag?

programme.title: ABC
programme.desc: For some people life is about triumph against all odds, for some; life is only about complexities. Some walk through this road aimlessly and some; actually become the bridge. ABC is a short film that showcases the dichotomy between two extreme yet simple individuals. It is an empowering film which has the dexterity & optimism to resonate amongst all sections of audience. As humans, we do tend to forget that we are but one world than just mere economy, that it can just take one human, just one moment, just one action to turn around the paths of millions. ABC; is just a sweet gentle reminder of this thought.

programme.title: Bridge
programme.desc: Mukesh is a widower and has a 28-year-old so Rahul. They live together and rarely talk amicably with each other. Rahul thinks his father is too weird for his age whereas Mukesh thinks why Rahul constantly judges him for his choices.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: Desh Ki Pardesh ?
programme.desc: The film follows the Parikh's on their visit to their children settled in the US. However, to only realize that there's a lot more than just a generation gap between them. Mainly, dawning upon Hasmuk Parikh's that it's great to dream big for your children, but one must be mentally prepared that those dreams may or not have them in it.

programme.title: ABC
programme.desc: For some people life is about triumph against all odds, for some; life is only about complexities. Some walk through this road aimlessly and some; actually become the bridge. ABC is a short film that showcases the dichotomy between two extreme yet simple individuals. It is an empowering film which has the dexterity & optimism to resonate amongst all sections of audience. As humans, we do tend to forget that we are but one world than just mere economy, that it can just take one human, just one moment, just one action to turn around the paths of millions. ABC; is just a sweet gentle reminder of this thought.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: ABC
programme.desc: For some people life is about triumph against all odds, for some; life is only about complexities. Some walk through this road aimlessly and some; actually become the bridge. ABC is a short film that showcases the dichotomy between two extreme yet simple individuals. It is an empowering film which has the dexterity & optimism to resonate amongst all sections of audience. As humans, we do tend to forget that we are but one world than just mere economy, that it can just take one human, just one moment, just one action to turn around the paths of millions. ABC; is just a sweet gentle reminder of this thought.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

Cruelty, barbarity, savagery, kindness, tenderness, love, in a world that gives not very much back. Set in the fictional present, an aging King invites disaster when he abdicates to his corrupt, toadying daughters, and rejects his loving and honest one.

programme.title: Redline
programme.desc: Redline is an auto/action thriller that features an extensive exotic car collection Phantom Rolls Royce, Lamborghini Murcielago, Enzo Ferrari, Ferrari F430, Ferrari Scaglietti and two Mercedes SLR McLaren AMGs. The film follows a gorgeous young automobile fanaticize driver who becomes part of illegal drag racing competitions organized by exotic car fanatics.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.title: The Deep Dark
programme.desc: 1956, northern France. When a group of miners are forced to take a professor underground with them for samples in the depths of a coal mine, they quickly realize that they are not alone and discover a crypt from another time, unknowingly waking up a bloodthirsty creature. One watchword: survival.

programme.title: Azaab
programme.desc: Azaab is a poignant period drama based on the tragic events of the 1947 Partition of India. The film portrays the pain, displacement, and emotional turmoil faced by families separated by the India–Pakistan partition.

programme.title: Patwaar
programme.desc: Gurpreet Chahal directorial Patwaar has an intriguing story about two best friends.

programme.title: Chandani
programme.desc: Chandni a makeup artist rejected for her complexion attempts suicide but is saved by her mother. A boy enters her life and transforms her world turning her shattered dreams into hope and happiness

programme.title: Rajneeti
programme.desc: Rajneeti' is a political thriller film, directed by Pali Bhupinder. It is the perfect blend of politics and relations

programme.title: Kuch Keh Nahi Sakde
programme.desc: Kujh Keh Nahi Sakde is a comedy film, which revolves around a family which has broken relationships.

programme.title: Lottery
programme.desc: Toti runs away from school and sits under a water tank where he meets a man and becomes Toti's friend, but Toti does not know that he is a drug addict. The turning point in the story comes when Toti realizes that he is a drug addict and thinks about quitting his addiction.

programme.title: Rabb Raakha
programme.desc: The film Rabb Raakhaa has a haunted story which will keep you at the edge of your seat.

programme.title: Sarpanchi Laini Aa

programme.title: Champion
programme.desc: Geeta and her father struggle to send brother Prakash abroad for education. He returns, marries a rich girl, and splits from family. They pay off the loan. Geeta falls for affluent Ranjit, whose father opposes.

programme.title: Thodi Thodi Si Manmaaniyan
programme.desc: Police Officer Ashwini Dixit struggles to solve a series of murders at a Manali club. When his wife is abducted, he must solve the murders and rescue her.

programme.title: Kya Yehi Pyaar Hai
programme.desc: Slacker Raja falls for studious Sandhya. He tries to woo her, unaware she fears her dangerous father.

programme.title: Pathar Ke Insan
programme.desc: Gifted singer Sita & renowned dancer Lata, talented sisters, compete in their careers. Their rivalry leads to a competition with far-reaching psychological consequences.

programme.title: Ghulam-E-Mustafa
programme.desc: An NRI student, a photographer, his friend, and a bank employee witness Kashmir's true spirit traveling across the region.

programme.title: Aag
programme.desc: A fun-loving girl falls for Prem Kishen, unaware she was meant for Prem Kumar.

programme.title: Ekka Raja Rani
programme.desc: Kathak dancer Barkha saves don Vishal, suffering minor injuries. He brings her home, where she meets his arrogant brother Sagar. They fall in love, but Vishal also likes Barkha. How will he react?

programme.title: Jail Yatra
programme.desc: Raju often gets jailed for trouble with police. When he gets involved with a gangster, he's in perilous danger, but no one believes him.

programme.title: Dariya Dil
programme.desc: Hardworking farmer Amar Singh gets a government tractor. His success and refusal of bribes anger his landlord, who assassinates him. Amar Singh's son, Vikraanta, seeks revenge.

programme.title: Albela
programme.desc: Tourist guide Tony is smitten by Sonia, who seeks her mother's grave in Goa. Believing she's his fated princess, he tries to woo her.

programme.title: 50 Lakh
programme.desc: When NCB offers a prize for capturing crime kingpin Irfan Khan, he plans to hijack a plane to Kathmandu, recruiting four unsuspecting men to assist him.

programme.title: Saath Saath
programme.desc: Avinash, a publisher, doesn't chase riches. But his wife's pregnancy brings financial strain, drifting him from his values.

programme.title: Aakhri Badla
programme.desc: A secret agent, his faithful sidekick, and a Japanese karate master combine their skills to take down an elusive international smuggling gang after their getaway ship carrying smuggled gold sinks in a cyclone.

programme.title: Maine Dil Tujhko Diya
programme.desc: College stud Ajay falls for business tycoon Ayesha. Her father opposes, influenced by a rival who plots Ajay's death. Ajay accepts a challenge to find Ayesha, unaware of a deeper conspiracy.

programme.title: Trishul
programme.desc: Vijay Kumar, illegitimate son of construction baron Raj Kumar Gupta, seeks revenge after his mother's death. He aims to destroy the Gupta family's business and connections.

programme.title: Suhaag
programme.desc: Blind writer Sandhya Bhatnagar, with a troubled past, meets a sadistic reporter claiming to be her fan. He coaxes her into revealing her past, leading to shocking truths.

programme.title: Krodhi
programme.desc: Abandoned as a young child, lonely Vicky finds affection in a teacher and Aarti. When Aarti's uncle sells her, she kills herself to escape assault. Enraged, Vicky becomes an underworld don, seeking revenge on her molesters.

programme.title: Ghar Ek Mandir
programme.desc: Brothers Prem, Vijay, and Ravi's lives are ruined when Prem is assassinated. Vijay is blinded by love for Sapna, who is a pawn in a scheme to destroy the family.

programme.title: Rajaji
programme.desc: A gold-digger marries a millionaire's daughter, abandons her, then woos her again when she wins a lottery, realizing she's the gardener's daughter.

programme.title: Ustadi Ustad Se
programme.desc: Staunch Jewish man Ezra adopts abducted Roman girl Lydia, raising her as a Jew. She falls for a Roman prince disguised as a Jew. Their relationship becomes public, causing complications.

programme.title: Black Mail
programme.desc: Young girls compete in a beauty contest, sharing a love-hate bond. One top contender is mysteriously murdered, prompting a police investigation.

programme.title: Vishwanath
programme.desc: Righteous public prosecutor Vishwanath is framed and imprisoned. Upon release, he seeks revenge, even if it means breaking the laws he once defended.

programme.title: Tathastu... So Be It
programme.desc: A complicated love triangle explores societal expectations versus personal happiness and free will, focusing on an unhappily married man who wants to keep his girlfriend without divorcing.

programme.title: Chhote Sarkar
programme.desc: A burly Inspector, trained to eliminate criminals, seeks to wipe out crime. He's assigned to protect a nine-year-old orphan, heir to millions.

programme.title: Johny Mera Naam
programme.desc: Separated by destiny, brothers Mohan and Sohan grow up fatherless. Mohan seeks to kill their father's murderer. Sohan becomes a cop, goes undercover as smuggler Johny, making life-changing discoveries.

programme.title: Ek Nazar
programme.desc: A 55-year-old aspiring storyteller wants to escape his priest legacy. He's jailed, unexpectedly finding an audience among prisoners for his dream.

programme.title: Waqt Ki Awaz
programme.desc: Lata runs from arranged marriage, falls for truck driver Vishwa. She's devastated when he's arrested for murder.

programme.title: Pyar Ishq Aur Mohabbat
programme.desc: Yash, Taj, and Gaurav are all madly in love with charming Isha, unaware of each other's personal agendas.

programme.title: Angel
programme.desc: Kailash's scientist uncle develops energy-saving formula. Jeevan's boss, Mehta, covets it, forcing Jeevan to retrieve blueprints, endangering Kailash and his love.

programme.title: Adventures Of Tarzan
programme.desc: Floods separate young Seema from friends Rajesh and Sanjay. Years later, she reunites with Rajesh and they plan to marry. On their wedding day, a woman appears claiming to be his wife with a child.

programme.title: Balwinder Singh Famous Ho Gaya
programme.desc: Two struggling Punjabi singers, both named Balwinder Singh, move to Mumbai to try films, fall for the same girl, and share a room.

programme.title: Soldier
programme.desc: Army Major Vijay Malhotra is murdered and falsely branded a traitor. His son Vicky becomes a soldier to avenge his death and clear his name.

programme.title: Tridev (1989)
programme.desc: An exiled police officer, a bandit, and a commissioner's son are framed by a smuggler. They unite to teach him a lesson and prove their innocence.

programme.title: Andolan
programme.desc: Three impoverished roommates, a driver, guard, and waiter, are offered easy, low-risk money by the security guard. Will the friends join him in a series of offenses?

programme.title: Rajjo
programme.desc: Rajjo, a nautch girl, and Chandu fall in love amidst Mumbai's dying Kothas, traditional art centers of singing and dancing.

programme.title: Maha Badmaash
programme.desc: Casino owner Ratan is forced to work for a gangster. When Ratan refuses to kill Commissioner Saxena, the gangster kidnaps his secretary and sister to blackmail him.

programme.title: Har Dil Jo Pyar Karega
programme.desc: Jahnvi's friend Pooja attempts suicide & is saved by singer Raj. Pooja falls for Raj upon recovery, but he loves Jahnvi.

programme.title: Pavitra Paapi
programme.desc: Criminal Sultan raises orphan Badshah, who becomes a criminal. Badshah changes for street performer Sapna, but Sultan returns to remind him of his past.

programme.title: Chaand Kaa Tukdaa
programme.desc: Crime Branch Officer Adhira Dixit risks her life investigating mysterious human and animal killings in the city.

programme.title: Gharana
programme.desc: Honest jeweler Prem Mehra loses wealth when rival Dharamdas and an employee steal his diamonds. His sons must now get everything back.

programme.title: Do Chor
programme.desc: An eloped couple works for a gangster disguised as a godman. Realizing the truth, they plan to dismantle his empire, while their families hunt them to break them apart.

programme.title: Kunwara
programme.desc: Raju and Urmila fall in love in New Zealand. In India, Raju helps pregnant Sharmila, posing as her husband, only to realize she's Urmila's sister.

programme.title: Rajnigandha
programme.desc: Twins Raja and Prem Malhotra are separated at birth. They reunite years later to defeat gangster Ratanlal, who aims to destroy their family.

programme.title: Deewana Tere Naam Ka
programme.desc: Two friends grow apart falling for same girl. She chooses Shankar over Shambhu. Shambhu allies with a mean-spirited Thakur's son, challenging Shankar to a boat race: loser leaves community.

programme.title: Ab Kya Hoga
programme.desc: Vicky calls his father for his birthday and plans to propose. Father dies in an accident. Vicky and Rani go missing en route to meet him.

programme.title: Dil Ka Rishta
programme.desc: Jai accidentally kills his lover's husband. When she gets amnesia, he comforts her, she falls for him. Guilt-ridden, he faces a dilemma: confess or reciprocate?

programme.title: Chirag
programme.desc: Greedy politicians use morality to seize a brothel's prime location. Relocation is unfeasible for the courtesans. Will they comply or fight back?

programme.title: Swarag Se Sunder
programme.desc: High-profile vigilante Arjun, working for police, seeks revenge on three crime bosses who destroyed his family by beheading his father and kidnapping his sister.

programme.title: Rickshawala
programme.desc: Siblings Radha and Ramu rise from poverty to become popular performers. Tragedy strikes. Ramu vows revenge on the man who exploited his mother, murdered his father, and tortured his sister.

programme.title: I Proud To Be An Indian
programme.desc: An indefinite flight delay strands 40 passengers, a blessing in disguise as couples of all ages reflect on their relationships.

programme.title: Vidhata
programme.desc: Kunal lives with influential grandfather Shamsher after parents' death, falls for Durga. Shamsher disapproves and plots to separate them.

programme.title: Dil Kya Kare
programme.desc: Kavita hires a caretaker for Neha, but her life turns upside down when the caretaker is revealed to be Neha's biological mother, and Anand the father.

programme.title: Sharafat Gayi Tel Lene
programme.desc: Young Prem gets a head injury saving brother Amar from criminal Sadhucharan. Brothers share unbreakable bond, unaware of Sadhucharan's revenge plans.

programme.title: Gone Kesh
programme.desc: The film follows teenage dancer Enakshi, who is diagnosed with alopecia, causing rapid hair loss.

programme.title: Welcome Wedding
programme.desc: A light-hearted surreal comedy targeting masses, a hilarious family entertainer.

programme.title: Nazrein Mili Dil Dhadka Meri Dhadkan Ne Kaha Love
programme.desc: Nazrein Mili Dil Dhadka Meri Dhadkan Ne Kaha Love

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Krishna is lovingly raised in Vrindavan, where harmony with nature and equality define village life. As Kans and Shukracharya plot his downfall by resurrecting the seemingly invincible Mahishasur—who hides his life and immortality in three magical flowers—danger quietly spreads. Disguised, Mahishasur targets Krishna’s loved ones to break him. Amid contests that celebrate intelligence, teamwork, and gender equality, Krishna protects Vrindavan through wit, illusion, and unity. False claims of Krishna’s death and rising terror test the villagers’ faith, but divine protection prevails. programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Krishna protects Vrindavan through divine illusion as repeated asur threats arise. Amid celebrations, Krishna’s playful leelas spark love, conflict, and social reform, while darker dangers loom with Netrasur, Bhasmasur, and new enemies threatening Vrindavan once more.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Netrasur, an asur descended from Bhasmasur, terrorizes Brindavan by shrinking its residents and threatening Krishna with ash-turning powers inherited from a dangerous divine boon. With help from Yaksh Kumaar, Krishna protects his friends and prioritizes their safety, even as Netrasur sets traps and demands obedience. Parallel intrigues unfold—Kansa schemes to revive Bhasmasur using sacred ashes, prophecies surrounding Prema’s marriage expose greed and destiny manipulation, and Shiva warns of cosmic imbalance without directly intervening. Through wit and deception, Krishna turns Netrasur’s own power against him, restoring all victims and reestablishing harmony in Brindavan. Festivities resume amid Diwali preparations, moral lessons on greed and reform are reinforced through a theft subplot, and while peace returns, unresolved conspiracies foreshadow greater trials ahead.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Superstition overtakes devotion in Vrindavan, letting Dhanupati exploit villagers with fake gods Gaddu and Buddhu. Krishna acts with strategy, not force, while Nand Baba leaves to protect the village, and Krishna later exposes Dhanupati’s greed. On Kansa’s orders, the asur Dhumrasur attacks—stealing cows, turning villagers into bats, and terrorizing the night. Krishna, aided by Lord Surya, defeats him while urging villagers to keep faith. Peace returns, but a new threat, Madhusur, looms as Krishna continues his playful, secretive protection of Vrindavan.

programme.title: Dalua Downhill
programme.desc: This is the journey of Douglas Rodrigues da Silva, aka “Dalua”, who is in search of the Downhill Skateboard world championship. This sport is among the most dangerous in the world where the skaters go downhill reaching speeds over 110 km/h. Over the course of two years, the film follows the Brazilian athlete in his travels around the world revealing that beyond the competition there is a story of determination, passion, pressure and pain. Friendship and rivalry awake some rowdy feelings between the athletes. It is this common bond between them that also what keeps them apart.
